verdict.rationale: Ramp's Developer API is visibly versioned: the canonical OpenAPI document is labeled v1, and endpoints sit under /developer/v1/ paths. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, changelog, or version-migration guarantees, so only half the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, changelog or breaking-change notice process, multiple-version support or migration guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
